pages.title: Topology Kiln
pages.text: A kiln for surfaces: clay is drawn into handles and cross-caps and fired until its shape holds.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the number of handles g, the number of twists (cross-caps) and the kiln's temperature. The surface has Euler characteristic χ = 2 − 2g − c, and it is one-sided if it has a cross-cap; both must be the recipe's. Hotter fires faster; above 1500 K the clay slumps.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Calabi-Yau Manifold, Differential Manifold, Hyperbolic Stone, Klein Bottle, Möbius Strip.
